text: Play on the a-file

text: We have chosen as the basic theme the question of planning play along the a-file, when it occurs with castling king's side by both opponents. Namely these cases of play along the a-file assume a specific character, requiring an independent examination.
zh: 我们选择的基本主题是当双方对手都在王一方易位时，沿着a字形进行对局的计划问题。也就是说，这些沿着a-file进行的案例具有特定的特征，需要进行独立检查。

text: What features characterise play along the a-file, with king's side castling by both sides? Firstly, the a-file is as distant as can be from the king's flank, as a result of which the principal events, for the time being, do ) not affecthe castled positions. Even more important is the fact thathe side holding the initiative in play on the a-file must concentrate largescale forces, and in any case the rooks, on that file or near it. It means that such play is attended by the diversion of important pieces from the king's flank. But this could 1 prompthe opponent to direct his forces to an attack there, in the event of which it is very important to take care of the defence of the king's flank with a solid pawn chain and a minor piece covering C detachment.
zh: 沿着a字形进行对局，王的一方由双方易位，有什么特点？首先，纵队距离王的侧翼尽可能远，因此主要事件暂时不会影响城堡的位置。更重要的是，在a线上掌握主动权的一方必须集中大规模兵力，无论如何都是车，集中在该列或其附近。这意味着这种对局伴随着从王翼转移重要棋子。但这可能会促使对手将他的部队引导到那里进行攻击，在这种情况下，用坚固的兵链和覆盖C分队的小棋子来保护王的侧翼是非常重要的。

text: The technique of opening the a-file consists of the exchange of the a-pawn for the b-pawn. Such an exchange is difficult to achieve if the b-pawn stands on its original square. Therefore it is useful, as a pre-requisite to opening the a-file, to provoke the advance of the knight's pawn one or two squares. There is no need to mention thathe plan of opening the a-file and the future invasion on it must be carefully thought out, taking into account all the concrete positional conditions, to weigh up whether it is possible for the opponent to advantageously preventhe opening of the a-file or launch a successful counter-attack on the king's flank.
zh: 打开a线的技术包括将a兵 替换为b兵。如果 b 棋子站在原来的方格上，这样的交换就很难实现。因此，作为打开a线的先决条件，促使马的棋子前进一两个方格是有用的。更不用说，他的打开A字形的计划以及未来对A字形的入侵都必须经过深思熟虑，考虑到所有具体的阵地条件，权衡对方是否有可能有利地阻止他打开A字形，或者对王的侧翼发动成功的反击。

text: In planning play on the a-file, it is of course necessary to secure the occupation of the opened line with his rooks. It means that an appropriate regrouping g of forces must take place even before the opening of the line.

text: In this most complicated and interesting game one circumstance attracts our attention. Black's most serious mistake, which might have led to his defeat, was the 13th move... d4, and yet it is precisely the d4 pawn which is the cornerstone of his successful pawn advance on the queen's flank! text: Two central pawns, standing side by side, hold under their influence four squares on the next rank. Thus the presence of the pawn centre for one of the sides predetermines a certain territorial achievement, which to some extent hampers the opponent, while in specific conditions might serve attack. The advance of the pawn centre sometimes causes real disarray in the enemy camp, particularly when a counterattack against such a breakthrough group proves unsuccessful. The pawn centre gains in strength when there is harmony between it and the pieceforces. If pawn support is required to consolidate a knight in the centre, then here the pawns need the support of pieces.
zh: 两个中央棋子并排站立，在其影响下占据下一排的四个方格。因此，一方兵中心的存在预先决定了一定的领土成就，这在一定程度上阻碍了对手，但在特定条件下可能会起到攻击作用。当兵中心的推进有时会在敌方阵营中造成真正的混乱，特别是当对这样的突破集团的反击被证明不成功时。当兵中心与兵力和谐时，它的力量就会增强。如果需要兵的支持来巩固中间的马，那么这里的兵就需要棋子的支持。

text: When the pawn centre advances, it loses touch with its own rear and draws closer to the superior strength of the opponent. text: Usually the side enjoying the initiative in this struggle is White, since, already with his first moves, he can maintain one of his pawns in the centre. text: We refer to the pawn phalanx. This name is given to some (most frequently two) connected pawns, out of which at least one is situated on an open file. The phalanx - this is clearly dynamic, connected with forward movement. This sort of pawn-pair potentially has dynamic capable ofbreaking power, through the enemy front. The central phalanx with pawns on the d and c-files is a very active weapon. Often another phalanx is met in practice, made up of the e and f-pawns; we give it detailed consideration in the next chapter. text: There is a quiet opening, where the first skirmish in the centre is a long time coming, and does not bring an advantage to either side. White begins the offensive first with the move f4, which had been tried time and again in practice and, up to this game, given good results for White. Even in the opening stage, Rubinstein thought out a plan of attack on the e4 square and foresaw that it would be weakened by the move f4. The attack launched by White looked dangerous, but required energetic and1 purposeful 1 execution. Duras was not able to permeate his play with concrete ideas, to map out a clear outline of the objective and a real way of achieving it. Separate passive moves began to interrupthe planned line of his thoughts, the attack came to assume a shapeless character, whereas Rubinstein continued purposefully f force to pressure on the e4 pawn. Soon this pressure was converted to an energetic attack by nearly all the Black pieces. The central stronghold of White's position - the e4 pawn fell, and this led to a disintegration of his king's flank.
zh: 有一个安静的开口，中间的第一次小冲突已经很久了，并且没有给任何一方带来优势。白方首先以f4棋开始进攻，这一棋在实践中经过多次尝试，到本局为止，白方取得了良好的效果。即使在开局阶段，鲁宾斯坦就已经想好了攻击e4方阵的计划，并预见到f4的举动会削弱它的力量。白方发动的攻击看上去很危险，但需要精力充沛、目标明确1执行力。杜拉斯无法在他的剧本中融入具体的想法，无法勾勒出清晰的目标轮廓和实现目标的真正方法。单独的被动动作开始打断他计划好的思路，攻击变得无形，而鲁宾斯坦则继续有目的地对e4棋子施加压力。很快，这种压力就转化为几乎所有黑方的猛烈攻击。白方阵地的中心据点——e4棋子陷落，这导致了白方王翼的瓦解。
